brief:
Hebron held a festival celebrating traditional agricultural and food products, drawing attention to the region's heritage crops and local farming practices. The event showcased locally grown items tied to Palestinian cultural traditions and historical agricultural methods in the southern West Bank district, the Ma'an news agency reported.

The festival provides a platform for farmers and producers to present heritage varieties and traditional food goods to local consumers and visitors, supporting continued cultivation of historically significant crops in the Hebron area.
title: Hebron hosts heritage agricultural food festival
